positions.title: Product Manager
positions.description:
DigitalService develops digital solutions for and with the German federal administration. Federal services should be just as easy for everyone to access and use as other digital products that we use regularly in our jobs and everyday lives. That is why users and their needs are consistently at the center of our product development. To achieve this, we bring together teams with expertise in software development, design and product management with the federal administration. Our goal: services that work better for everyone.

Current project: Neues Rechtsinformationssystem (short: NeuRIS). Specifically: Interne Rechtssprechung
Previous project: App developement (BundesIdent) within digital identities project

positions.title: Product Fellow
positions.description: As part of the federal innovation initiative Tech4Germany, I worked as a product manager on a twelve-week project with the German Bundestag. Our development team implemented a software for the German Bundestag that distributes resources such as speaking minutes in plenary sessions, committee seats or office space.

positions.title: Product Developement (CDTM Cooperation)

Our team developed a cloud-based tool to help automate the final assembly check of heavy diesel engines (maritime, generator sets, military etc.) right before the engines are delivered to the customer. The project involved working in an interdisciplinary team using various design thinking frameworks with the end goal of creating value for the assembly-line workers.

My tasks:

- Brainstorming and prototyping
- Technical development of a mobile web application (Frontend)

company.name: DigitalService
company.description:
As the digitalization partner for public administration, DigitalService has set itself the goal of sustainably advancing the digital transformation of Germany. The aim is to make user-centered digital services the standard in public administration.

To achieve this, DigitalService works closely with the federal government to develop and operate innovative digital solutions through interdisciplinary teams while establishing the necessary foundations.
